item.title: DEATH ANGEL Announce Second Leg of ‘Act III US Tour’, Feat. Guests VIO-LENCE + INCITE
item.description: Thrash metal legends DEATH ANGEL have announced the second leg of their Act III US Tour. The excursion, featuring guests VIO-LENCE and INCITE, will kick off May 1st in Phoenix, AZ and will wrap June 21st in Santa Cruz, CA. Presale tickets are available now, and public onsale starts Friday. item.title: CONJURER Announce North American Tour with Sadness, Snooze & Pains
item.description: Following the success of last Fall’s Unself LP (Nuclear Blast), UK heavyweights CONJURER are finally bringing their sonic devastation to North America. The 16-date onslaught launches May 22nd in NYC, carving a path through Montreal, Chicago, and Nashville before a final showdown in Philly on June 7th. Don’t miss a stacked support bill featuring SADNESS, SNOOZE, and PAINS. CONJURER comments, […]

item.title: BLEED FROM WITHIN Release Live Video for ‘Zenith’, UK + Ireland Tour Kicks Off Today
item.description: Scottish metal heavyweights, BLEED FROM WITHIN, are preparing to take their adrenaline-charged live show further across the Northern Hemisphere. Tonight, they’ll be hitting the UK and Ireland for an extensive 11-show run, followed by a colossal month-long trek across North America. item.title: NOUMENA Return with New Single ‘Kuolemankello’ – Epic Journey into Finland’s Dark History
item.description: Hailing from the heart of Finland, the masters of melodic death metal, Noumena, are making their long-awaited return.
